page.layout: One page of running text in one column; a marginal note in the left margin, beside the line "minum frequentia"; a catchword at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.p: mittunt eam ad judices ordinarios. Iidem Quatuor-viri soli, si qua vendenda ex rebus monasticis, quae usum jam non habent, vendunt: de pecunia, quae ex lo-cariis, aut rebus venditis provenit, se-cundum leges sibi disponunt, quibus sol-vendum, solvi jubent: id curae habent, ne qua fraus à conductoribus quoquo modo Reip. fiat, ne Quaestores solutio-nes quae controversia vacant, tardent, neu quicquam cuiquam solvant temere aut pro arbitrio suo. Usi sunt prioribus annis ministerio Quaestorum duorum: nunc utuntur unius. Is à conductoribus exigit locaria annua, & si quid censuum aliorum, exacta, & in indices suos relata ex voluntate Quatuor-virum horum manibus ipsorum signata rursum expendit: omnium rationes reddit cum libris Quatuor-virum collatas, auscultantibus etiam iis, quos Ordines provinciae ad eam rem edunt. page.notes: Marginal note at left, set in italic, reads "Ordo pu-" / "blicanorū." and is transcribed as one note. Catchword "vinciali" at lower right. The faint stamp at the lower right corner and the marks at the lower left are digitiser or scan marks and are left out. Running head abbreviations are kept as printed, with long s rendered as s.
